# Vendored dependency

`rough.min.js` is the bundled browser build of [RoughJS](https://roughjs.com/)
v4.6.6 (MIT License, see `ROUGHJS_LICENSE`), used to render the dungeon map
with a hand-drawn, sketchy line style. It is vendored (embedded inline in
the generated HTML) rather than loaded from a CDN so the generated page
stays fully self-contained and works offline.
